files.help:
Supported since _v4.0.0_ of the Johnny.Decimal CLI, `jd`.

Move each item:

- _$HOME/.jd/config.json_ to _$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/johnnydecimal/config.json_
- _$HOME/.jd/journal.jsonl_ to _$XDG_STATE_HOME/johnnydecimal/journal.jsonl_
- _$HOME/.jd/cli_ to _$XDG_DATA_HOME/johnnydecimal/cli_. Then change the path in the `source` line of your shell config.

`jd paths` prints the commands for your machine.
